metadata.overall_mood: Ultra-minimal editorial. Large semi-transparent lowercase letterform laid over live video. Beauty is in the see-through — subject bleeds through letterform fill.
metadata.treatment_notes: SEE-THROUGH LETTERFORM TREATMENT (TYPO #37): Single word 'less.' rendered as a large semi-transparent letterform in warm terracotta/salmon tone (~rgba(232,196,160,0.72)) positioned over live video. The principal subject (talking head) is visible THROUGH the letterform fill. The treatment creates depth via alpha transparency rather than animation. Letterform sits mid-frame, partially overlapping the subject. Heavy sans 700-900 weight, lowercase.

layout_rules.placement_note: Large letterform centered over mid-frame, overlapping the principal subject's torso/lower-face area. The subject's face is visible through the transparent letterform body.

typography_layers.font_classification: Heavy Geometric Sans-Serif or Transitional Sans — Large Letterform

font_style.color_notes: Semi-transparent warm terracotta/salmon. The alpha (~0.72) is critical — the video subject shows through the letterform. Do NOT use solid fill. Exact color: warm skin-tone peach.

effects.treatment_note: NO drop shadow, NO glow, NO animation. The semi-transparency IS the entire treatment. The beauty is the video subject bleeding through the letterform body.

placement.z_depth_note: Text sits in front of video, behind any UI overlays. Subject video is at z_index: 0, this text at z_index: 2.
